prompt: 已经有 export adapter readiness 和显式 export plan 了，请规划怎么导出 wiki；先不要安装依赖、运行 Quartz/Obsidian/static 工具、生成 artifacts、发布、上传或写文件。
expected_route: Publish / Export Wiki / P4.4 export planning.
must_not: run Quartz, Obsidian, static publishing tools, package-manager scripts, shell commands, or export commands
generate, write, move, delete, upload, publish, or serve export artifacts
start preview servers, local servers, or MCP processes
treat an explicit export plan as execution confirmation
checks: consumes P4.1 export readiness and explicit export plan as evidence only
names source scope, target/profile, output root, dependency boundary, rollback or cleanup, and confirmation gates
keeps readOnly true and all export/write/install/command/upload/server flags false when present
marks source scope as needs_confirmation and outputRoot.willWrite false
does not execute export tooling or write export artifacts
